1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea con tallos de hasta 25 cm de longitud, hojas con folíolos, flores rosadas o violáceas y fruto capsular cilíndrico. Oxalidaceae, Oxalis spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Herbaceous plant with stems up to 25 cm in length, leaves with leaflets, pink or purple flowers and cylindrical capsule fruit. Oxalidaceae, Oxalis spp.
